what: Over an always-drawn 1px underline, a hidden background-colored mask appears the moment you hover and sweeps from outside the left edge to outside the right edge in 1.4s expo.inOut. It is a “gap sweeping through” underline: erased from the left, then immediately revealed again from the left. On release the mask returns the same distance from right to left, then hides.

options.ease: Curve — Bezier values like 0.87,0,0.13,1 or a css curve name, default expo.inOut (inOutExpo, drawn with linear())
options.--fx-gap: Curtain color — same as the background behind the underline (via style), default var(--kf-bg). On a gold panel, use that panel’s color
options.[data-fx-part=line] · [data-fx-part=gap]: (If present) a 1px line element and the curtain inside it — if absent, the part creates and attaches one

note: The curtain is a real element, so it turns on (display) the moment a hand is placed and turns off only after it has fully run back on exit — like the original. Web Animations is used so it starts on the very frame the event fires (GSAP draws its first frame on the next tick, which measured about 30ms late). The underline is drawn at the element’s bottom, so the user sets the space below the text with line-height·padding. With reduced motion, only the underline remains
